异名：
Echeveria pusilla A.Berger (1904)
Echeveria purpusii Britton (1905)
Echeveria microcalyx Britton & Rose (1911)Series Paniculatae
圆锥花序系（译注：此系名下仅有子持白莲和花乃井两个物种）Distribution Mexico (Puebla, Veracruz)
栖息地：墨西哥（普埃布拉，韦拉克鲁斯）Description (according to IHSP 2003) :
形态描述（根据IHSP2003版）：Stem to 5 cm or more, 3 – 5 mm in diameter, branching.
茎干5厘米或更长，3 - 5毫米直径，多分枝。Rosette 2,5 – 5,5 cm in diameter.
莲座直径2.5到5.5厘米Leaves obovate-spatulate, cuspidate, 1 – 2 x 0,7 – 1,5 cm, ± 4 mm thick near tip, glaucous-green, often red-tipped.
叶倒卵状匙形，骤尖，1 - 2厘米长×0,7 - 1,5厘米宽，叶尖附近±4毫米厚，覆盖白霜的绿色，常有红尖。Inflorescences laxly cymose-paniculate with cincinni, ± 10 – 20 cm long, bracts minute, 4 – 10 (-20) mm, easily detached, pedicel slender, 1 – 3 cm.
花序为稀疏的聚伞-圆锥状蝎尾花序，±10 - 20厘米长，苞片极小，4 - 10（-20）毫米长，容易脱落，花梗纤细，1 - 3厘米。Flowers : Sepals slightly spreading, < 3 mm, corolla cylindrical, 7 – 9 x ± 4 mm in diameter near the base, salmon-orange.
花：萼片稍开展，<3毫米。花冠圆筒形，7 - 9mm长，接近基部约4毫米直径，鲑鱼橙色。Cytology : n = 33,66.
细胞学检查：N =33,66。Echeveria microcalyx differs mainly in having slightly larger leaves and in growing taller.
与微萼石莲花的区别主要是稍大的叶型和较高的株高Plant in habitat, Laguna de Aljojuca, Puebla, Mexico :
